blocks.html: Robinsons Communities: A warm welcome for Escalades East Tower

Robinsons Communities adds another completed project to its growing portfolio of affordable and quality residential projects with the on-going turnover of the 15 storey Escalades East Tower located along 20th Avenue in Cubao, Quezon City.

Touches of the modern-Filipiniana architectural theme are evident as residents and guests enter the generously-sized and cozy lobby of Escalades East Tower. Meanwhile, at the amenity level located at the 4th floor, homeowners can enjoy various rest and recreational activities encouraging family and community bonding. Make your weekends extra special by inviting friends over for a refreshing dip by the pool. Take gaming to a more intimate level as you engage with fun and familiar board games at the picturesque family room. Adjacent to the family room, is a function room crafted specially for celebrating important family milestones like your child’s first birthday, a recent promotion, or your wedding anniversary. Your health and well-being is also a priority at the Escalades East Tower as the development comes equipped with a fitness area. The kids are also up for a delightful home experience as the landscaped garden has a large outdoor play set where they can bounce around and play all day.
Aside from these fun and functional amenities, Escalades East Tower will soon have its own retail facility at the ground floor focusing on providing the basic needs and services of the residents.

All these basic home conveniences at Escalades East Tower are made even more stress free for all homeowners as the project’s strategic location allows easy access to the main thoroughfares and transportation systems (LRT-Line 2 and MRT stations). Furthermore, residents can expect short travel time to commercial areas and well-known schools all located nearby such as: Gateway Mall, Smart Araneta Coliseum, Trinoma, Farmer’s Market, University of the Philippines, Ateneo de Manila University, and Miriam College.

Take this opportunity to get a warm and friendly home at Escalades East Tower, with selected ready-for-occupancy units available. A preview of this charming lifestyle may also be seen with the on-site model unit available for viewing. For site tripping appointments and price and unit inquiries you may get in touch with us by: calling our Robinsons Communities sales hotlines at 0932-700-0000, connecting with us on Facebook(RobinsonsCommunitiesPH) or logging on to www.robinsonscommunities.com.
